title: The Bright Archive
author: Sebastian Crane
blurb: Wendell Oyelaran, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
